archetypes.name: VP Rush Donor
archetypes.philosophy: Maximize bullet income through tree farming and aggressive donation to reach 1000 VP before the enemy can establish a army.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), prioritize tree planting (increase probability to 0.5) before hiring gardeners or building units
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), reduce BULLET_RESERVE from 100 to 20 to allow more aggressive donating
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), hire gardeners only when bullets exceed 500 to maximize tree planting
In runArchon(), reduce random movement to stay near planted trees for better defense
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive posture around archon and tree farms; minimal combat units, focus on economy over elimination

archetypes.name: Tank Fortress
archetypes.philosophy: Build a heavy tank-based defense around the archon, using tanks as mobile cover while grinding down enemy forces.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), change shouldBuildSoldier() to shouldBuildTank() with 0.2 probability when bullets > 350
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), hire gardeners aggressively to support tank production (probability 0.3)
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), plant trees only defensively around archon location
Add new method shouldBuildTank() that checks rc.canBuildRobot(RobotType.TANK, dir) && bullets > 350
archetypes.engagement_style: Static defensive formation; tanks form perimeter around archon, soldiers fill gaps, engage enemies at range

archetypes.name: Scout Swarm
archetypes.philosophy: Overwhelm the enemy with fast, cheap scouts that scout aggressively, collect bullets from neutral trees, and harass enemy gardeners.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), change shouldBuildSoldier() to shouldBuildScout() with 0.4 probability
Add new method shouldBuildScout() that checks rc.canBuildRobot(RobotType.SCOUT, dir) && bullets > 100
In runScout() (new method to add), implement aggressive patrol behavior moving toward enemy archon locations
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), reduce tree planting to minimum (probability 0.05) to maximize unit production
archetypes.engagement_style: Highly mobile harassment; scouts split into pairs, target enemy gardeners and archons, avoid direct combat with tanks

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Aggressive early-game rush using lumberjacks to clear paths and strike enemy units before they can establish defenses.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), change shouldBuildSoldier() to shouldBuildLumberjack() with 0.5 probability
Add new method shouldBuildLumberjack() that checks rc.canBuildRobot(RobotType.LUMBERJACK, dir)
In runLumberjack(), modify to move directly toward enemy archon location broadcast coordinates (channels 0,1)
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), hire gardeners very aggressively (probability 0.5) in first 500 rounds
archetypes.engagement_style: All-in early aggression; lumberjacks rush enemy archon, strike anything in path, prioritize enemy gardeners

archetypes.name: Tree Economy Maximizer
archetypes.philosophy: Maximize passive bullet income through extensive tree farming, creating an economic advantage that enables late-game victory.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), increase shouldPlantTree() probability to 0.8 and hire gardeners aggressively (0.4)
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), build soldiers only when gardener count exceeds 3 (new check)
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), reduce BULLET_RESERVE to 50 to invest more in trees
In runArchon(), plant trees immediately upon spawning before moving
In runGardener(), prioritize tree planting around neutral trees and archon vicinity
archetypes.engagement_style: Economic expansion; gardeners spread out to plant trees, soldiers defend tree farms passively, build overwhelming economy

archetypes.name: Soldier Horde
archetypes.philosophy: Mass produce soldiers to create overwhelming numbers advantage, swarm enemy positions with cheap, expendable units.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), increase shouldBuildSoldier() probability to 0.6 when bullets > 150
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), hire gardeners very aggressively (probability 0.5) to maximize production facilities
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), plant trees rarely (probability 0.02) to focus all resources on soldiers
In runSoldier(), implement swarm behavior: move toward nearest enemy but maintain 2-unit spacing
archetypes.engagement_style: Mass swarm tactics; soldiers move in groups of 3-5, coordinate firing on single targets, overwhelm through numbers

archetypes.name: Archon Hunter
archetypes.philosophy: Target priority: hunt enemy archons first and foremost, sacrificing economy to eliminate the enemy HQ quickly.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), similar to Lumberjack Rush but with mixed unit composition
In runSoldier() and runLumberjack(), implement enemy archon targeting: read broadcast channels 0,1 to get enemy archon location
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), hire 2 gardeners quickly then go all-in on combat units
In runArchon(), prioritize movement toward enemy archon after initial defensive period
archetypes.engagement_style: Direct assault; all units move toward enemy archon, ignore other targets unless blocking path, all-in elimination focus

archetypes.name: Balanced Adaptable
archetypes.philosophy: Flexible strategy that adapts to opponent: build economy against passive enemies, rush against aggressive ones, maintain balanced army.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), implement adaptive spending based on round number: early economy, mid-game army, late-game VP
Add logic to detect enemy aggression level by monitoring broadcasted enemy positions
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), round 1-300: 60% gardener/40% soldier; round 301-600: 30% gardener/70% soldier
In runSoldier() and other units, implement defensive behavior when enemy detected nearby, offensive when no threats
archetypes.engagement_style: Reactive gameplay; units defend when threatened, push when safe, adapt composition based on enemy observed units

archetypes.name: Gardener Killer
archetypes.philosophy: Economic warfare: target enemy gardeners exclusively to cripple their unit production and economy, then finish with superior economy.
key_changes: In runSoldier() and runScout(), prioritize targeting GARDENER type robots when in range
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), similar to Scout Swarm but with soldier focus for better combat
In runSoldier(), add logic: if enemy gardener sensed, ignore other targets and focus fire on gardener
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), maintain 2-3 gardeners, then prioritize anti-gardener units
archetypes.engagement_style: Economic disruption; units actively seek and destroy enemy gardeners, avoid archons until economy crippled

archetypes.name: Map Control Mobile
archetypes.philosophy: Establish map control through strategic positioning: control neutral trees, chokepoints, and bullet deposits while maintaining mobile army.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), moderate tree planting (0.3) balanced with unit production
In runArchon(), implement strategic positioning: move toward map center or neutral tree clusters
In runSoldier() and runScout(), implement patrol routes between important map locations
Add Scout units specifically for bullet collection from neutral trees and early map vision
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), maintain 40% of bullets as reserve for strategic flexibility
archetypes.engagement_style: Map control gameplay; scouts gather intel and bullets, soldiers hold positions, army pushes from secured positions
